question: How do I log in to GridPulse?
answer: Drivers: click 'Login' on the start page, enter your email and password and click 'Login'. There is no code at login: your email was checked with a code when you signed up. Admins use the separate 'Admin Login' page (link 'Admin? Login here'), also with email and password.

question: How do I create a new account or sign up?
answer: On the login page click 'Signup'. Fill in username, email, a 10-digit mobile number that starts with 6, 7, 8 or 9, your date of birth (drivers must be 18 or older), your driving license number (DL and 4 digits, like DL1234; it is saved once and cannot be changed later), a strong password (8 to 64 characters, no spaces, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a special character) and confirm the password, then click 'Signup'. We email you a 6-digit verification code (valid for 10 minutes) to check that the address is yours: type it in and click 'Verify'. The account is only created after the right code. No email? Click 'Send a new code' (one per minute) or 'Change my details' to fix the address. Every new account is a driver (User). After the success popup you are sent back to the login page.

question: Why does it say Invalid Email or Password when I log in?
answer: The email is not registered or the password does not match. Check for typos and caps lock. Drivers log in on the normal login page and admins on the 'Admin Login' page - using the wrong page also shows this message. If you have never signed up, create an account with 'Signup' first.

question: I forgot my password, how can I reset it?
answer: Click 'Forgot password?' on the login page, enter your email and click 'Send Code'. We email you a 6-digit reset code (valid for 10 minutes). Type the code and your new password, then log in with the new password. This works for drivers and admins.

question: How do I log out?
answer: Click the round profile icon on the right of the navbar, choose 'Log Out' and confirm the popup. Your session is cleared and you are taken back to the login page (admins to the Admin Login page).

question: What is the difference between the Admin and User roles?
answer: Admins are race control: they add and edit tracks, approve or reject registrations, run the Live Race Control Board and read all feedback. Users are drivers: they browse tracks, register for races, follow Live Timing and give feedback. The Super Admin can do everything an Admin can and also adds, lists and disables admins.

question: Why am I sent to the error page when I open some pages?
answer: Admin pages are only for Admins (and the Super Admin) and driver pages are only for Users. Opening a page of the other role, or a page that does not exist, shows the error page ('This page is off the track'). If you are not logged in you are sent to the login page instead.

question: How can I see the available race tracks?
answer: Log in as a driver and open 'Tracks' > 'View Tracks'. Every track card shows its picture, category, location, the lowest session price and how many sessions are open. Use the search box to filter by name, location or category.

question: What track categories are there?
answer: GridPulse tracks are Circuit, Karting, Rally or Drag Strip, and each one is marked as Indoor or Outdoor.

question: How does an admin add a new race track?
answer: As an Admin open 'Tracks' > 'Add Track', fill in name, description, location, category, indoor/outdoor, opening and closing time and facilities, add 1 to 5 pictures and click Submit. Track names must be unique. The price is set on each session, not on the track.

question: Why can't I delete a track?
answer: A track that has sessions (and with them bookings, results and feedback) is never deleted, so its history stays. Use 'Deactivate' on 'Tracks' > 'View Tracks' instead: the track is hidden from drivers and can be activated again later. Only a track that never had a session can be deleted.

question: How do I edit a track's details or opening hours?
answer: As an Admin go to 'Tracks' > 'View Tracks' and click 'Edit' on the track. The form opens with the current values, change what you need and click 'Update Track'.

question: How do I book a session or register for a race?
answer: Go to 'Tracks' > 'View Tracks', click 'Register' on a track and pick the race date. Pick one of the sessions the admin scheduled for that day, enter your car number, choose the car category, tick the Terms & Conditions box and click 'Pay & Register'. You pay in the Razorpay window and the booking is saved as Pending. You do not type a time: date, time and price come from the session.

question: How is the price of a booking calculated?
answer: Every session has its own price, set by the admin when the session is created. A booking costs exactly that price, shown as 'Amount payable' before you register. For a competition you pay the entry fee once when you book qualifying, your place in the race is free.

question: Can several drivers share the same session?
answer: Yes. A session has a maximum number of cars. Any number of drivers can register and wait as Pending. The admin approves cars until the session is full; everybody still waiting then goes on the waitlist (no refund yet), and a booking made for a full session joins the waitlist too. When a seat opens (an approved car cancels, or the admin adds seats) the oldest waitlisted booking moves up to Pending. Whoever is still on the waitlist when the session starts is rejected and refunded in full.

question: Why is my car number already taken?
answer: Each car number can be used only once in the same session. Pick a different number, or a different session. A rejected booking gives its number back.

question: What time can I book a session for?
answer: You book one of the sessions the admin has scheduled - you cannot choose your own time. Pick a date on the registration page to see that day's sessions with their time, price and free seats. A session can be booked until it starts; a full session can still be booked, the booking then joins its waitlist.

question: What does Pending, Approved, Rejected or Waitlisted mean on my registration?
answer: Every new registration starts as Pending. Race control (the Admin) then approves or rejects it and you get an email about it. Waitlisted #n means the session is full and you are number n in the queue: you move up to Pending by yourself when a seat opens, and if none opens before the start you are refunded in full. A rejection always comes with the reason the admin wrote: it is in the email and under 'Show More' on 'My Registrations'.

question: How do I cancel my registration?
answer: Open 'Tracks' > 'My Registrations' and click 'Cancel' on your booking. A Pending or Waitlisted booking is refunded in full. An Approved booking can be cancelled while the session has not started, but the amount is not refunded. A Rejected booking can be taken off your list with 'Remove'.

question: Where can I see all my bookings?
answer: As a driver open 'Tracks' > 'My Registrations'. It lists your bookings with date, time slot, car number, status and a live race status column, and 'Show More' opens every detail including the total price.

question: What is the Live Race Control Board?
answer: It is GridPulse's live timing screen. For a practice session the admin opens 'Practice Control', picks a track, a date and a session, then starts cars, adds laps or retires them in real time. A competition has its own 'Competition Control' page. The leaderboard re-sorts instantly and refreshes every 4 seconds.

question: How do I watch live timing of a race?
answer: As a driver open 'Live Timing', choose the track, the date and the session. You get the same live leaderboard as race control, refreshing every 4 seconds, but without the action buttons.

question: How is the leaderboard ranked?
answer: Cars that are not retired come first, then more completed laps rank higher. Equal laps are broken by who completed their last lap earlier, then by the lower car number.

question: How does race control add a lap or retire a car?
answer: On the Admin 'Practice Control' board click 'Start' on a car first (it becomes RACING), then '+1 Lap' to count each lap or 'Retire' to retire it. The buttons disappear once a car is RETIRED or FINISHED.

question: What do Finish Session and Reset Session do?
answer: 'Finish Session' freezes the current order: every car still running gets its final position and becomes FINISHED, and the session is completed. 'Reset Session' (after a confirmation) sets every car back to 0 laps and NOT_STARTED - it only works before the session is finished.

question: What do the race states NOT_STARTED, RACING, RETIRED and FINISHED mean?
answer: NOT_STARTED: no lap counted yet. RACING: at least one lap counted. RETIRED: the car was retired by race control. FINISHED: the session was finished and the car got a final position, shown as e.g. 'Finished P3' on My Registrations.

question: How do I give feedback about a track?
answer: Feedback is about a session you drove in. Once that session is finished, open 'Feedback' > 'Add Feedback', select the session, give a star rating (1 to 5), write your feedback (at least 10 characters) and click Submit. The 'Improve with AI' button suggests clearer wording for your text. You can give one feedback per session, and your name is added automatically from your login.

question: How can I see or delete my feedback?
answer: Open 'Feedback' > 'My Feedback' to see everything you have written. Click 'Delete' and confirm the popup to remove an entry.

question: Who can read the feedback I give?
answer: Admins see all feedback on the 'Feedbacks' page, together with the track, the session and your profile (username, email and mobile number) so they can follow up.

question: How do I contact GridPulse support?
answer: Call 123-456-7890 or use the contact details on the Home page. This assistant can also answer questions about accounts, tracks, bookings, live race control and feedback.

question: How do I become an admin or add a new admin?
answer: Signing up always makes a driver account. Only the Super Admin can add admins: on the 'Admins' page they enter the new admin's name and email, and the admin gets an email with a link to choose a password (the link works once, for 48 hours; the Super Admin can send a new one). The admin then logs in on the 'Admin Login' page. The Super Admin can also disable or enable an admin there.

question: How does an admin create a session?
answer: As an Admin open 'Sessions' > 'Add Session', pick a track and one of the two types. Practice: date, start time, end time, price and max cars. Competition: a name, a date, a qualifying time slot, a race time slot and an entry fee. A session must lie inside the track's opening hours and cannot overlap another session on the same track.

question: What is a competition and how does it work?
answer: A competition is one event with two sessions: Qualifying and Race. Drivers book it once (the qualifying session). The admin runs it step by step on the Competition Control page: Start Qualifying, Finish Qualifying (the result becomes the starting grid), Start Race and Finish Race (final results). The number of qualifying laps, race laps and the maximum number of cars come from the track's category.

question: What are the terms and conditions of a booking?
answer: You accept them with the checkbox on the registration form: you pay when you book. A full session puts your booking on its waitlist: it moves up when a seat opens, and if none opens before the start the full amount is refunded. If GridPulse rejects your booking, or you cancel it while it is still Pending or on the waitlist, the full amount is refunded. You may also cancel an approved booking, but then the amount is not refunded.

question: Can an admin edit or cancel a session?
answer: Yes, while the session is still SCHEDULED: open 'Sessions' > 'View Sessions' and use 'Edit' or 'Cancel' on a practice session. Cancelling rejects every booking in it and the drivers are told by email. A competition is cancelled from its Competition Control page before qualifying starts.

question: Can I book a session in the chat?
answer: Yes, once you log in. Logged in, this chat becomes the GridPulse Copilot: drivers can find and book sessions, cancel bookings and give feedback; admins can manage tracks, sessions, competitions, bookings and refunds. Every change shows a card with a Confirm button and only happens when you press it. Without logging in, the chat answers questions from this FAQ list.
